summary: Verified all 5 navigation bug fixes on iPhone 390x844 viewport using maggie demo account. All critical scenarios pass: (1) Profile/Lounge/Friends tile taps stay on target screen (no bounce to Home); (2) Flutter + Friend-Request buttons on /friends stay on /friends (toast appears, URL unchanged); (3) Daily Butterfly Bonus claim stays on /games (no bounce); (4) BrandLockup tagline 'FIND YOUR PEOPLE' now renders at 13px (bumped from ~7px) on the 140px home lockup. Welcome + login screens still render cleanly with no red-screen errors. One minor caveat on web preview only: at the smaller 140px lockup on 390px viewport the tagline text visually truncates to 'FIND YOUR ...' because RN Web doesn't honour adjustsFontSizeToFit; on native iOS this would shrink instead of clipping — non-blocking for TestFlight but worth a follow-up.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390px web viewport the 'FIND YOUR PEOPLE' tagline visually truncates to 'FIND YOUR ...' at the 140px home lockup width because React Native Web ignores adjustsFontSizeToFit. Size did increase from ~7px to 13px per the fix; iOS native will shrink correctly. Consider clamping tagSize by width or setting numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit + explicit letterSpacing scaling. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BrandLockup.tsx:68

action_items: Optional polish: fine-tune BrandLockup tagline sizing so 'FIND YOUR PEOPLE' fully fits within a 140px lockup on RN Web (native iOS already handles it via adjustsFontSizeToFit). Not required for the TestFlight bug fix batch.

games/index.tsx claimBonus correctly dropped auth refresh() (fix verified).
events.tsx and notices.tsx both pass backHref='/home' to Header (fix verified).

Note: home.tsx still destructures `refresh` from useAuth on line 22 and calls it in flutterBack() line 129 — this path is not covered by the current 5 bug fixes but uses the same pattern that caused the friends.tsx bounces. If a Flutter-back tap ever bounces to Home, this is the culprit.
